title: DevCraft Order Record
description: The exact output contract for Objective 1. Field names and types are fixed and MUST NOT be modified. See DATASET_CARD.md for the scoring policy, the attribute key vocabulary, and the needs_clarification decision rule.

customer.description: Customer name if stated or clearly implied in the message, else null.

items.description: One entry per distinct item ordered. Empty array is valid when no item can be identified (see needs_clarification rule (a)).

description.description: The item, normalised to lowercase singular. Scored by token-set F1 >= 0.80 against gold.

quantity.description: Count ordered. An unmarked item means 1.

attributes.description: Keys MUST come from the domain vocabulary in x-devcraft-vocabulary. Unknown keys are scored as wrong.

due_date.description: ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD), resolved against the input record's received_at in Asia/Kolkata. null when no deadline is stated, or when a stated deadline cannot be resolved.

amount.description: Money stated in the message, in INR, as a number without currency symbols. null if not stated.

references_prior_order.description: true when the message refers to a previous order ('last time jaisa', 'pichli baar wala').

confidence.description: Self-reported confidence. NOT SCORED in Test A; used only as a tie-break. Emit it anyway - the schema requires it.

needs_clarification.description: true iff a REFERENCED field cannot be resolved. A field that is simply absent is null, not a clarification. See DATASET_CARD.md.

x-devcraft-input-format.description: Records you are given (train) and that judges feed you (test) have this shape. received_at is an INPUT field and is the anchor for every relative date.

example.message: bhaiya 2 kurta chahiye navy blue, chest 40, parso tak ho jayega kya? last time jaisa hi

x-devcraft-vocabulary.description: Closed set of attribute keys per domain. Emitting a key outside this list scores as wrong.
